import pandas as pd

path = 'budget.xlsx'
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)

for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {sheet} (shape {df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60, max_cols=30))

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

MAIN = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'

z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
ws = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
sheet_data = ws.find(f'{MAIN}sheetData')

# Check for formula elements anywhere (e.g. Total Income B8, Total Expenses C23, Balance B25)
formulas = []
for row in sheet_data.findall(f'{MAIN}row'):
    for c in row.findall(f'{MAIN}c'):
        f = c.find(f'{MAIN}f')
        if f is not None:
            formulas.append((c.get('r'), f.text))

expenses = []
by_cat = {}
for row in sheet_data.findall(f'{MAIN}row'):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    if 11 <= r <= 22:
        cells = {c.get('r'): c for c in row.findall(f'{MAIN}c')}
        cat_c = cells.get(f'A{r}')
        amt_c = cells.get(f'C{r}')
        cat = cat_c.find(f'{MAIN}v').text if cat_c is not None and cat_c.find(f'{MAIN}v') is not None else None
        amt = amt_c.find(f'{MAIN}v').text if amt_c is not None and amt_c.find(f'{MAIN}v') is not None else None
        expenses.append((r, cat, float(amt)))
        by_cat.setdefault(cat, []).append(float(amt))

print("Formula cells in sheet:", formulas)
print("\nExpense line items:")
total = 0.0
for r, cat, amt in expenses:
    total += amt
    print(f"  Row {r}: {cat:16s} {amt:8.2f}")

print(f"\nGrand total (rows 11-22, col C): {total:,.2f}")

print("\nPer-category subtotals:")
cat_total = 0.0
for cat, amts in by_cat.items():
    s = sum(amts)
    cat_total += s
    print(f"  {cat:16s} {s:8.2f}  ({', '.join(f'{a:.2f}' for a in amts)})")
print(f"  {'CHECK':16s} {cat_total:8.2f}")

# Sanity check: every value numeric, no negatives
assert all(isinstance(a, float) for _, _, a in expenses)
assert total == cat_total
print("\nValidation OK: all 12 amounts are numeric; category subtotals match grand total.")
